ExtraBar 1.5.2 – Suggestions, Codex & ChatGPT! ✨🤖

Let your assistant propose a bar built around the apps you actually use — and connect it in one click.

✨ New Features

  • ExtraBar Suggestions: Ask your assistant to personalize ExtraBar and it builds a setup for you, asking before it changes anything!
  • Codex and ChatGPT Support: One command in Settings → AI Assistant connects them, and onboarding can do it for you!
  • Assistants Can Do More: Run your saved actions and read the result, and edit widgets in place instead of recreating them!

🔧 Improvements

  • Approve Once, and It Runs: No second click, and renaming or re-icon'ing an action no longer asks again!

🔒 Safety & Control

  • Scripts Run Exactly as Written: The shell you picked, and approved script files can't change behind your back!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Works on a Clean Mac: Everything the AI connection needs now ships inside the app!

⚠️ Please Note

  • Re-Save 1.5.0 Script Actions: Approved AI script-file actions from 1.5.0 need to be opened and re-saved once!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
